I have farmed this rice plot near the lake for many years, and I know what works for me. I do not buy chemical fertilizer or manure for this plot because they cost too much and the rice grows well enough in the wetland soil with the rains. I keep my own seed from last season, and my family does all the planting, weeding by hand, and harvesting together, so I do not need to pay workers.
